Mother and two children die after falling from fort bastion in Maharashtra

A woman and her two children died after falling from a bastion at Naldurg Fort in Maharashtra. The five-year-old son and the mother died at the scene. One of the twin daughters succumbed to her injuries during treatment. The coverage indicates the woman had three children, and three fatalities occurred.
